description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the correctness of data mapping functions between network models, database entities, and external models in the 'Now in Android' project. It specifically tests the conversion of NetworkTopic and NetworkNewsResource objects to their corresponding internal entity and external model representations.

classes.description: Test class containing unit tests for network model conversions used in the Android project.

methods.description: Tests conversion of NetworkNewsResource to database entity and verifies field mappings.
